description: This file defines functions for installing Google Maps related custom fields and logic hooks in a SuiteCRM project. It sets up hooks for various modules to update geocode info and manage relationships, and provides custom field definitions for geolocation data.

methods.name: install_gmaps
methods.description: Main function to install Google Maps features, including custom fields and hooks.

methods.name: installJJWHooks
methods.description: Sets up logic hooks for various modules to handle geocoding and relationships.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Returns an array of custom field definitions for geolocation data across multiple modules.
